metadata.name: Julia Gillard
metadata.description: Australian Labor prime minister whose minority government enacted carbon pricing and disability and school reforms, while retaining offshore asylum processing and opposing same-sex marriage during her premiership.
metadata.scope: Personal positions and governing conduct during 2010–2013. Coalition measures are attributed cautiously. Modern hypothetical policies are labelled inferred, not claimed as direct statements. Research cutoff 4 October 2026; later views do not overwrite a former governing period.
